title: A Fable session dispatching a formula revision to Opus
brief: Today is {{TODAY}}. Harness: Claude Code desktop app. The harness reports this session's model as claude-fable-5-1 at effort xhigh.
The session usage tool reports tokensUsed 254,081, contextWindow 1,000,000 and autoCompactsAtPercent 97. This session has not been compacted.
A fresh session in this harness and project starts at 86,450 tokens (measured: the usage tool's total less its Messages category).

Next stage: specify and implement a revision of a decision procedure's arithmetic across three modules (a Markdown procedure, a calculator script and a check script), choosing which cost terms the formula keeps, and add one worked example. The choices between designs are part of the stage. Plan estimate: 60 turns. It is a writing-heavy stage at high effort; no per-turn measurement exists.
A fresh session would read: the assessment (7,000 tokens), the procedure (4,700), the check script (2,800), an example (2,300), a template (700) and the handoff (2,500).
A handoff for this stage would be about 100 lines. If an acceptance session were used, it would take about 15 turns and read about 30,000 tokens.
Everything this session knows that the next stage needs is already written in files on disk.
No cache-miss measurement exists, and no review pauses are expected during the stage.
The stage writes files and commits locally; nothing leaves the machine.
notes: F is the step 1.2 default; O is the writing-heavy figure of step 1.2.
The split is cheaper than fresh but is not an option: choosing the formula's terms is the design, so no brief can carry a contract that settles them.
